setup_notes: Semua model menggunakan HasUuids (Laravel 11) — primary key UUID non-incrementing, auto-generate saat create

Urutan migration penting: corporates → companies → business_units → stations → machinery → users → weighbridge_records → grading_records → grading_details → cages_track_records → cages_tipped_times (users harus sebelum 3 record table karena FK checked_by/acknowledged_by/created_by)
User model extends Authenticatable + HasApiTokens (Sanctum), auth password memakai kolom password_hash (bukan konvensi default password)
Factory classes (database/factories/) belum dibuat — di luar scope entity-models-agent (model/migration saja); trait HasFactory sudah terpasang di tiap model
Belum dijalankan composer install / php artisan migrate karena vendor/ belum ada di scaffold ini — perlu dijalankan manual setelah shared-modules selesai untuk validasi terhadap database sungguhan
